title: Kissed Syrian Peanuts Kebabs
description: Jammy, tender peanuts glazed with honey and sumac, finished on the grill for a smoky finish. A macrobiotic-friendly twist on a classic Syrian snack.
instructions: Preheat your sous-vide water bath to 60C.
In a bowl whisk together honey, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, sumac, and smoked paprika until smooth.
Place the raw peanuts in a vacuum-seal bag and pour the glaze over them, ensuring even coating.
Seal the bag tightly and immerse it in the preheated water bath, cooking for 120 minutes.
After cooking, remove the bag, open it, and transfer the peanuts to a parchment-lined sheet.
Broil or grill the peanuts on high heat for 3-5 minutes, turning once, until they develop a caramelized crust.
Sprinkle chopped mint and toasted sesame seeds over the hot peanuts.
Serve immediately, letting the warm steam mingle with the aromatics.
